name: HSBC
verdict: HSBC is owned by its listed holding company, HSBC Holdings plc. The major shareholdings notified to HSBC Holdings are asset managers and a depositary (BlackRock 9.09%, Ping An Asset Management 7.98%, BNY Mellon 6.01%); no state is in the chain. Nothing found.
note: LIV Golf 'Global Pillar Partner' (livgolf.com/partners); also a partner of Crushers GC and Majesticks GC. Front-of-shirt sponsor (Principal Partner) of the Hong Kong China Rugby men's and women's teams: HSBC's white hexagon is across the chest of the official 2026/27 15s home replica (HKCR shop product photos).
